summary.value: Constitutional amendment to repeal Section 31 of Article I of the California Constitution. The Legislature adopted it and filed it with the Secretary of State on June 25, 2020 (Resolution Chapter 23, Statutes of 2020); it appeared on the November 3, 2020 ballot as Proposition 16, which received 7,217,064 yes votes (42.8%) and 9,655,595 no votes (57.2%).

citations.quote: A resolution to propose to the people of the State of California an amendment to the Constitution of the State, by repealing Section 31 of Article I thereof, relating to government preferences.
